basic_details.job_title: CPDO Upper Division Clerk Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Central/State Government official holding an analogous post on regular basis, or with eight years regular service as Lower Division Clerk (Pay scale Rs.5200-20200, Grade Pay Rs.1900/- pre revised, Level-2), and possessing a Bachelor degree from a recognized university or equivalent
qualification.details: Qualification: Official of the Central Government/State Governments holding analogous posts on regular basis; OR; With eight years regular service in the post of Lower Division Clerk in the Pay scale of Rs.5200-20200 with Grade Pay Rs.1900/- pre revised and Level-2 (Pay matrix) as 7th CPC; Possessing Bachelor degree from a recognized university or equivalent Experience: Eight years regular service as Lower Division Clerk (Level-2), where the candidate does not hold an analogous post on regular basis | Other conditions: | Open only to officials of the Central Government / State Governments Application must be forwarded through proper channel

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay scale Rs.5200-20200 with Grade Pay Rs.2400 (pre revised); Level-4 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the proforma attached to the notice, neatly typed.
Affix a recent passport size colour photograph in the space provided on the proforma.
Get the employer's endorsement (Head of Office) certifying particulars, no vigilance case and integrity.
Enclose duly attested copies of up to date APARs for the last five years.
Send through proper channel in a cover super-scribed 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF UPPER DIVISION CLERK' to the Director, CPDO(NR), Chandigarh.
Send within 60 days of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 8 January 2027.
important_instructions: Head of Office must certify that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the applicant and state the applicant's integrity

rows.central_poultry_development_organization: Pay scale Rs.5200-20200 with Grade Pay Rs.2400 (pre revised); Level-4 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix
Central Poultry Development Organization (NR), Industrial Area, Phase-I, Chandigarh

Central/State Government official holding an analogous post on regular basis, or with eight years regular service as Lower Division Clerk (Pay scale Rs.5200-20200, Grade Pay Rs.1900/- pre revised, Level-2), and possessing a Bachelor degree from a recognized university or equivalent

The Director, Central Poultry Development Organization(NR), Chandigarh, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Industrial Area, Phase-I, Chandigarh-160002

content_sections.heading: CPDO Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. C.P.D.O.(NR)/Chd./2026/149 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CPDO notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Official of the Central Government/State Governments holding analogous posts on regular basis; OR; With eight years regular service in the post of Lower Division Clerk in the Pay scale of Rs.5200-20200 with Grade Pay Rs.1900/- pre revised and Level-2 (Pay matrix) as 7th CPC; Possessing Bachelor degree from a recognized university or equivalent Experience: Eight years regular service as Lower Division Clerk (Level-2), where the candidate does not hold an analogous post on regular basis Other conditions: Open only to officials of the Central Government / State Governments Application must be forwarded through proper channel

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for CPDO Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date, without APARs or otherwise incomplete will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation for a period not exceeding three years Pay plus deputation (duty) allowance, or pay fixed in the post's pay scale, at the official's option as per Government of India rules/orders

content_sections.heading: How Will CPDO Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection on deputation basis from eligible officers working in Central Government / State Governments.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed proforma, neatly typed Recent passport size colour photograph affixed on the proforma Duly attested copies of up to date APARs for the last five years Endorsement by the employer (Head of Office) with signature and seal

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Head of Office must certify that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the applicant and state the applicant's integrity

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CPDO Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CPDO Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Upper Division Clerk.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CPDO Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma for Applicant and Endorsement by the Employer, pages 4-5 of this notice) and send it to The Director, Central Poultry Development Organization(NR), Chandigarh, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Industrial Area, Phase-I, Chandigarh-160002, by through proper channel, in a cover super-scribed 'application for the post of upper division clerk', to reach by 8 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay scale Rs.5200-20200 with Grade Pay Rs.2400 (pre revised); Level-4 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Central/State Government official holding an analogous post on regular basis, or with eight years regular service as Lower Division Clerk (Pay scale Rs.5200-20200, Grade Pay Rs.1900/- pre revised, Level-2), and possessing a Bachelor degree from a recognized university or equivalent.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to officials of the Central Government / State Governments. Application must be forwarded through proper channel.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the due date, without APARs or otherwise incomplete will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection on deputation basis from eligible officers working in Central Government / State Governments.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation for a period not exceeding three years. Pay plus deputation (duty) allowance, or pay fixed in the post's pay scale, at the official's option as per Government of India rules/orders.

faq.answer: Central Poultry Development Organization (NR), Industrial Area, Phase-I, Chandigarh.
